text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
From here on, the days of racing through the Twinkle Series
with my partner Umamusume would begin.
The name of the girl who walks alongside me is—

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
I am Satono Crown.
Upon the Satono name, I shall seize the crown of glory!
I look forward to working with you!

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
"On the path we walk, surely
all manner of hardships will stand in our way..."

text_block_list.name: Satono Crown
text_block_list.text:
“Still, don't worry!
The higher the wall, the more fired up I get!”

text_block_list.name: Narrator
text_block_list.text:
And so, our challenge for the Twinkle Series
with <chrname> began!
